issue.title: Task Decay: one ladder, two stays per rung, one card
issue.description: Repeated freshness keeps on WIP, Next, Ready, and P-level tasks follow one consent-based decay ladder (WIP → Next → Ready → P1 → … → P4): each rung allows a configured number of due Alt+F keeps (Bryan: 2), then the next due keep opens one rung-aware decay card whose Enter steps the task exactly one rung down and whose Alt+F stays and restarts the count; every keep, stay, step, and drop writes one rung-qualified Rotten Log entry; WIP keeps log to the Rotten Log instead of the Work Log; and the Ready card's "no priority ladder is configured" bug is fixed.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/task_decay_ladder.md requests this work
